ability.name: Lash of the Sire
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:
• If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of the move. • If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.
ability.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords^^** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

ability.name: Unbending Will
ability.effect: Add D6 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Deathrattle^^** or **^^Deadwalkers^^** unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Unhinged Rampager
ability.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.
